title: Ledger: revenue, invoices and receipts
summary: An append-only, hash-chained revenue ledger (company/work/ledger/ledger.jsonl), separate from AI spend: invoices from delivered commitments, receipts, payouts, credit notes instead of edits, reconcile by a seat other than the one that invoiced, and a revenue summary. Ships closed: no invoice is sent until the owner sets the currency and the external gate clears the recipient.

tools.purpose: append-only hash-chained revenue ledger: invoices, receipts, payouts, credit notes, reconcile, summary

limits.why: the module's own caps; shipped closed, opened only by the owner

meters.why: the revenue ledger: append-only, hash-chained; corrections are credit notes
every invoice that left, with its gate clearance
